name: aqg-audit-adjudication
description: Decide accept / reject / needs-user-decision for each Claude Opus, Gemini 3.1, o3, Codex internal-review, or local-audit finding and produce a structured adjudication table for AI team project work. Use AFTER any audit / review / second-opinion returns with a list of issues to integrate before fixing code, especially for production-adjacent scripts, ADRs, decision packets, CI failures, or evidence artifacts.

sentence_patterns: I have a list of review issues — accept/reject each one
走 audit adjudication 流程, 整合 findings
Decide what to do with the gpt-5.5 + gemini findings

cli_contract.0: success — adjudication table parsed and shape valid
cli_contract.1: validation failed — missing/extra columns, malformed decision values, or row mismatch
cli_contract.2: usage error — argparse propagates exit 2 on bad args

owner_only_actions: Production / branch protection / Owner-admin actions remain separate authorization gates

cases.prompt: Just finished a /audit standard review — 8 findings to integrate before I fix
Code review came back with 12 issues — decide accept/reject for each
The deep review gave me its reasoning — I need an adjudication table to decide which fixes to land
Second-opinion review just landed — produce the structured decision table
Use /aqg-audit-adjudication to integrate this round's audit findings
